To file a Level 1 standard appeal, you must submit your request in writing or call the plan within 65 calendar days from the date on the written notice of the coverage decision. [1]
To file a Level 1 fast appeal, you or your doctor must contact the plan and explain why your health requires a fast appeal. You can make the request in writing or by calling the plan. [1]
For a Level 1 appeal to extend care, you must contact the Quality Improvement Organization by noon of the day before the effective date on the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage. [2]
If your Level 1 appeal is denied, you can file a Level 2 appeal with the Independent Review Entity (IRE) within 65 calendar days from the date on the written notice of the Level 1 decision. [3]
If the plan does not complete its review within the required timeframe, your appeal will automatically be forwarded to the Independent Review Entity (IRE) for a Level 2 appeal. [3]

A grievance is also called a complaint. [1]
Filing a grievance is the process of making a complaint. [1]
An expedited grievance is called a fast complaint. [1]
To file a grievance, you can contact Member Services by phone at 1-888-778-1478 (TTY users call 711). [1]
You can also file a grievance in writing and send it to Clover Health. [1]
If a representative files a grievance on your behalf, they must provide proof of legal representation or complete an Appointment of Representative form. [1]
The grievance process is used for problems related to quality of care, waiting times, customer service, and other issues like cleanliness or privacy. [2]
Examples of grievances include dissatisfaction with the quality of medical care, disrespectful behavior, or delays in getting appointments. [2]
